blocks.text: Fraser Valley Rural Properties, Hobby Farms & Agricultural Land Listings

parts.t: Discover the newest Fraser Valley acreages for sale, including hobby farms, estate properties, agricultural land, and rural homes across Abbotsford, Aldergrove, Langley, and Mission. Whether you're searching for
open land,

equestrian-ready space, or a private retreat, this page shows all active MLS® acreage listings in one place. I’m Jared Gibbons, a Fraser Valley real estate expert specializing in acreages and rural properties. I help buyers understand zoning, ALR rules, well and septic considerations, and the unique challenges that come with country living. If you’re exploring rural living or need professional guidance on a property, I’m here to help. Explore
Campbell Valley acreages
for additional rural options.

blocks.text: Space, Privacy & Views Across the Fraser Valley

parts.t: Fraser Valley acreages offer exceptional rural lifestyle and investment opportunities across one of BC's most scenic and productive agricultural regions. These diverse properties attract buyers seeking everything from small hobby farms to large agricultural operations, equestrian estates to country retreats with space and privacy. If you're focused specifically on the Township, browse
Langley acreages for sale

The valley's fertile soil, mild climate, stunning mountain backdrops, and supportive agricultural community make diverse pursuits viable from berry farming to viticulture, horses to market gardens. Properties span from Langley to Chilliwack and beyond, each area offering distinct character,
zoning

, and opportunities with varying proximity to urban amenities and services. Buyers appreciate reasonable pricing compared to similar acreages closer to Vancouver, plus the genuine country lifestyle while remaining within commuting distance for those balancing urban careers. The Fraser Valley delivers authentic opportunities. Before you buy, see our
guide to buying farmland in BC
. I can help navigate the diverse valley acreage market—contact me for available properties and recent rural sales across all Fraser Valley communities. For more options, explore
Fraser Valley farms for sale.
For acreage on the Surrey side of the border, browse
South Surrey farms and acreage.
